name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for targeted criminal provisions and platforms’ responsibility to effectively address cyberbullying and online harassment
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking for stronger action against cyberbullying and online harassment. It wants the European Commission to check whether the European Union needs one shared definition of cyberbullying and whether the worst cases should count as serious cross-border crimes. It also wants online platforms held responsible for keeping users, especially children, safe, and it calls for better reporting tools, support for victims, and rules on harmful artificial intelligence tools.

- The Parliament asks for EU-wide rules and tougher enforcement; nothing changes in law yet.
- Children, women, minorities and victims of online abuse would benefit most.
- The Commission must now decide whether to propose new laws.
